title: DNA segment capture by Smc5/6 holo-complexes
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生化重构与交联实验研究Smc5/6复合物对DNA的拓扑装载与环捕获机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且涉及结构机理，但无AI或物理模拟方法，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Three distinct SMC complexes facilitate chromosome folding and segregation in eukaryotes, presumably by DNA translocation and loop extrusion. How SMCs interact with DNA is however not well understood. Among the SMC complexes, Smc5/6 has dedicated roles in DNA repair and in preventing a lethal buildup of aberrant DNA junctions. Here, we describe the reconstitution of ATP-dependent topological DNA loading by Smc5/6 rings. By inserting cysteine residues at selected protein interfaces, we obtained covalently closed compartments upon chemical cross-linking. We show that two SMC subcompartments and the kleisin compartment topologically entrap a plasmid molecule, but not the full SMC compartment. This is explained by a looped DNA segment inserting into the SMC compartment with the kleisin neck gate locking the loop in place when passing between the two DNA flanks and closing. This DNA segment capture strictly requires the Nse5/6 loader, which opens the neck gate prior to DNA passage. Similar segment capture events without gate opening may provide the power stroke for DNA translocation/loop extrusion in subsequent ATP hydrolysis cycles. Our biochemical experiments thus offer a unifying principle for SMC ATPase function in loading and translocation/extrusion, which is likely relevant to other members of the family of SMC proteins too.
abstract_zh: 三种不同的SMC复合物通过DNA易位和环挤压促进真核生物中染色体的折叠和分离。然而，SMC如何与DNA相互作用尚不十分清楚。在SMC复合物中，Smc5/6在DNA修复及防止异常DNA连接致死性积累方面具有专门作用。在此，我们描述了通过Smc5/6环实现ATP依赖性拓扑DNA装载的重建。通过在选定的蛋白质界面插入半胱氨酸残基，我们在化学交联后获得了共价闭合的隔室。我们展示了两个SMC亚隔室和kleisin隔室拓扑捕获了一个质粒分子，但并非完整的SMC隔室。这可以通过一个环状DNA片段插入SMC隔室来解释，其中kleisin颈部门在通过两个DNA侧翼之间时锁定环状片段并关闭。该DNA片段捕获严格依赖于Nse5/6装载因子，该因子在DNA通过前打开颈部门。在随后的ATP水解循环中，类似的片段捕获事件（无需门打开）可能为DNA易位/环挤压提供动力冲程。因此，我们的生化实验为SMC ATPase在装载和易位/挤压中的功能提供了一个统一原则，这可能也适用于SMC蛋白家族的其他成员。
